title: Groups
description: Collections of people that share access. Grant a role to a group and every member inherits it.

empty.title: No groups found
empty.description: Try a different search or clear the filters.
empty.firstDescription: Create a group to grant the same access to many people at once.

form.createDescription: Groups bundle people so you can grant roles once instead of person by person.
form.editDescription: Changes are recorded in the audit log.
form.name: Name
form.keyHint: Used by integrations and directory sync. Lowercase letters, digits, “-” and “_”. It can't be changed later.
form.keyTaken: Another group already uses this key.

detail.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted, or you no longer have access to it.
detail.summary: {members, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} · {roles, plural, one {# role} other {# roles}}
detail.deleteBody: {count, plural, =0 {This group has no members.} one {Its # member will lose any roles granted through this group.} other {Its # members will lose any roles granted through this group.}} Accounts themselves are not affected. This can't be undone.

members.removeSelected: Remove {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}

empty.title: No members yet
empty.description: Add people to give them the roles granted to this group.

members.everyoneBody: Membership is implicit: every active person belongs to this group automatically ({count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} right now), so it can't be edited here. Grant roles to this group to give everyone baseline access.
members.syncedNotice: Membership is managed by directory sync ({source}). Manual changes may be overwritten on the next sync.
members.removeTitle: Remove {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}} from “{group}”?
members.removeBody: They lose any roles granted through this group. Their accounts are not affected.
members.removed: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody was removed} one {Removed # member} other {Removed # members}}

members.addConfirm: {count, plural, =0 {Add members} one {Add # member} other {Add # members}}
members.added: {count, plural, =0 {Everyone you picked was already a member} one {Added # member} other {Added # members}}

roles.title: Roles granted to this group
roles.description: Every member of the group receives these roles.
roles.emptyDescription: Members only get access from their own roles and the Everyone group.
